# Changelog

Every release of Danganronpa RPG, newest first, with a link to its notes. Generated by `node tools/changelog.mjs
--write` from `.github/release-notes/`; do not edit by hand (`node tools/check.mjs notes` holds it to that folder).

- **1.2.112** - the dead as Spectators, the table's dice look, the player and GM screens' cleanup, tooltips across the module, the action grid in the owner's order, the curtain under the windows, every field of the case planner, and the second security round's tests ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.112.md))
- **1.2.111** - Facilities and the Infiltrate tile, the Class Trial's exit, the case planner's plans and its Close that saves, text fields that float while edited, windows that fit and first opens warmed at idle, a project token's glyph, the release tooling and 1.2.110's low findings ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.111.md))
- **1.2.110** - Rules before 1.3.0, the Monocub's new moves and the dead's own voice room, the stage notes' leftovers, the trial console's steps, and the owner's fixes from the table ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.110.md))
- **1.2.109** - The Class Trial's entry and the verdict's cut-in, the clock's turns with a direction, the Investigation's flashes and the body's flicker, the day's boards and the school's mood, the Spectator; on Daggerheart 2.12 the GM draws the players' rolls again ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.109.md))
- **1.2.108** - The Class Trial console rebuilt: one large window with the status on top, the trial's read-out on the left, the chapter's case schema on the right and the GM's bar at the bottom; the schema ticked node by node while the trial runs, with hints after presentations and a summary of only what was found for the players after the verdict; and three new trial modes played by standing in the hall's two zones - Straw Poll, Logic Dive and Scrum Debate - with the trial's Findings ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.108.md))
- **1.2.107** - The case map: the Investigation panel opens on a Map of the chapter's case, the Table one switch away for each GM; the GM builds deductions, counters and the solution there, on nodes shown whole and edited on themselves, in a map that pans and zooms, checks the case, and realizes the Key Remnant plan with a preview and an undo; every Remnant can name who left it, for the GMs alone ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.107.md))
- **1.2.106** - Newer Daggerheart and Foundry: a player's save in Daggerheart 2.12.5's shape no longer dropped, no player's roll drawn by the GM on Daggerheart 2.12 until its new action road is reworked, Dice So Nice 6.4's saved marker held with the table's dice look; the harness runs Foundry's old keys both ways ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.106.md))
- **1.2.105** - Monokuma Legacy at parity with Stained Glass, one hand-drawn glyph set, gold for Hope alone and the GM's mic lock drawn; one settings window for every seat, the game's settings behind the GM panel, Season setup with its checklist, the character settings window and a glyph for each statistic; Details in every action window; a body tile at every death, gone when a Class Trial ends; Foundry's look covered in the places a survey found it showing through ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.105.md))
- **1.2.104** - The body stays where it fell and is announced on every screen; the player proposes the statistic and the GM approves, changes or refuses it on one card; Take from the Body rolls Hand, only the first roll for a Take counts, and a witness means a Shadow cover; one wide layout for every action; Breakdown and Wounded on the sheet, not the token ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.104.md))
- **1.2.103** - The GM's large windows on one layout kit: Room setup, the item windows, Sound, Despair Flow, Season setup, the Class Trial console and the vote, the incident tracker, Murder, Edit campaign, the GM panel and one case window, Investigation, Students with a Role, Level Up and Items on every row, the project windows and the new surfaces, and the fix round of comparisons 2 and 3 ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.103.md))
- **1.2.102** - Foundry's notifications back where Foundry puts them (the curtain's top right whole again), no orange mark in the module's checkboxes and radios, "3 / 4" with no "Left:" on Health and Sanity, Observe back in the actions' one layout, no sideways scroll in the kit windows, Health vermilion and Sanity teal, the curtain's recolour a true crossfade, and the voice tile at the right wall, in the middle of the right side, with its buttons on its own pane ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.102.md))
- **1.2.101** - the curtain's glass moves as glass, the track band stays in the clock, the pause and the Eclipse on the clock, the Projects tray in rows, the board visible on a narrow screen, the prompts over the sheet; Health and Sanity as what is left, Sanity and the Breakdown icon private, the biography that saves, Not in the class and Mark as Monokuma on the sheet, the module's own state icons, one sheet mode and a sheet that repaints in place ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.101.md))
- **1.2.100** - every module window on the kit's frame, the buttons' language: red only for the GM's road and an irreversible answer, the primary in Bone, one footer with the closing word on the left, Observe that stands still, the Stop in view, the keyboard rule on touch only, and the character sheet that folds ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.100.md))
- **1.2.99** - one window kit for the module's windows, every window folds, tabs of equal width on one line, one number stepper, notices under the windows in Stained Glass and over them in Monokuma Legacy, the project icon at full opacity, Delete a Remnant on the Investigation dashboard, and a project's description on its token's card ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.99.md))
- **1.2.98** - a GM sets every Remnant's visibility, found or not, on the Investigation dashboard and on the Remnant's own card, a GM sees a player's 3D dice only with that GM's Monokuma in the room, the player's roll window is whole, the table's Hope and Despair dice wear one look, and Set the season up checks the dice look ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.98.md))
- **1.2.97** - players are asked "Done" or "One moment" before the clock moves, every time of day ends with its summary, both verdicts list every student, and a verdict, an End of chapter or a season reset that stops halfway is finished from where it stopped ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.97.md))
- **1.2.96** - one road for numbers, lists, dates and names, one name for every action, option and Call in English and Polish, and 59 rewritten texts the owner approved; players and GMs see new names and new texts ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.96.md))
- **1.2.95** - one style guide, one glossary and a text lint for every text the module shows, with a pilot of rewritten texts the owner read and approved; nothing changes at the table ([notes](.github/release-notes/v1.2.95.md))
